findings.headline: Move this Solid web renderer static import.
findings.why: Solid 2 publishes the web renderer from @solidjs/web instead of the solid-js/web subpath.
findings.guidance: Do not move Suspense and mergeProps with the module source: replace Suspense with Loading from solid-js; replace mergeProps with merge from solid-js after reviewing its undefined-value semantics. Move only render to @solidjs/web, preserving aliases and quote style.
